notes.title: BIG CHANGES COMING
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
After watching game play and getting good feedback, and completely redoing the a.i 100 percent all around!

Since I already have a really good base set up straight with bluerpints I can assure you this will be a 100 percent improvment. Not saying there are going to be bugs, but this weekend I will be working on this around the clock. 

Hopefully with a little luck monday morning will have a brand new build out!
